ITEM 1 | Pale white mashed mass with lumpy, irregular texture and soft, slightly moist surface, spread across the left-center of the plate in a mound about 12 cm wide and 13 cm tall, occupying roughly 30% of the plate's visible area | 260
ITEM 2 | Chunky reddish-orange sauce with visible small pieces and flecks, glossy and moist, sitting in two blobs on top of the white mound, about 6 cm wide and 1.5 cm thick at its highest point | 90
ITEM 3 | Cubed golden-brown pieces with browned, crisp-looking edges and soft interiors, about 2 to 3 cm per cube, mixed with darker olive-green pieces and reddish sauce, piled in a heap about 9 cm by 8 cm and 2.5 cm high on the right side of the plate | 170
ITEM 4 | Whole dark red grapes, smooth, glossy and plump, about 1.5 to 2 cm in diameter, arranged in a loose cluster along the right edge of the plate beside the cubed items, roughly 9 grapes | 110
ITEM 5 | Watermelon pieces with bright pink-red flesh, moist and juicy surface, cut into irregular cubes about 2.5 cm per side, arranged in a small cluster at the bottom right of the plate, about 8 cm by 6 cm and 2 cm high | 110
